hooks.command: json=$(cat); sid=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.session_id' | cut -c1-8); prompt=$(echo "$json" | jq -r '.prompt'); printf '[%s] session:%s | %s\n' "$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" "$sid" "$prompt" >> .claude/prompt-history.log

if [ -n "$SPLITMATE_DOC_UPDATE_RUNNING" ]; then exit 0; fi; input=$(cat); if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then export SPLITMATE_DOC_UPDATE_RUNNING=1; { echo "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] SessionEnd doc update triggered (reason: $(echo "$input" | jq -r '.reason'))"; claude -p '/update-readme'; claude -p '/update-claude'; } >> .claude/session-end-doc-update.log 2>&1; fi
